$comment: Declares the intent of each committed data file so validation can distinguish a real problem from a deliberate one. 'valid' (default) must parse cleanly with no quality warnings; 'synthetic' must parse cleanly but may be degenerate; 'invalid' must fail to parse.

dataset/demo_session.csv.why: Realistic six-driver session used for the README screenshots.

dataset/demo_lap_trace.gpx.why: Realistic three-lap GPS trace used for the map, gradient and replay.

dataset/scale_10k_laps.csv.why: Deliberately repetitive 10k-lap file that exercises parse and render performance. Not representative telemetry.

fixtures/clean_session.csv.why: Minimal happy-path fixture; Luigi intentionally has a single lap.

fixtures/messy_columns.csv.why: Exercises BOM, CRLF and shuffled column order.

fixtures/leaderboard_test.csv.why: Small three-driver session for leaderboard highlighting and sorting.

fixtures/malformed_errors.csv.why: Every row is broken on purpose, to prove the parser reports errors instead of throwing.

fixtures/kart_track.gpx.why: Simple square loop used for lap-segmentation unit tests; speed is intentionally uniform.
